announcements.headline: Update on Composite Scheme of Arrangement
announcements.insight: As a composite scheme involving both UPL and its subsidiary UPL (Holdings), this update is critical for resolving the long-standing dual-listed structure that has historically suppressed valuation multiples due to complexity and liquidity fragmentation. The progress of this de-dualisation directly addresses investor demands for simplified capital structures, similar to recent successful demergers in the FTSE 250.
